svg.aria-label: Animated comparison: ASPECT keeps a fixed Eulerian box while material flows out through the sides and the top boundary moves vertically; DES3D nodes move with the material so the whole mesh widens, then goSPL erodes the surface
svg.text: Material leaves through the fixed walls; mesh lines do not move
FastScape returns h_new; top boundary moves at v_z = (h_new − h_old)/Δt
Dashed: initial box (same as the current box)
Box edges stay put; material flows out through the sides
Top boundary moves only vertically (mesh velocity, z only)
Nodes move outward with the material; the box widens past the dashed initial box
goSPL returns erosion and deposition only; the uplift already happened in DES
Dashed: initial box (the padded goSPL mesh must cover beyond it)
Nodes carry the material; the whole mesh widens and remeshes
goSPL mesh is fixed, so it needs padding around the initial surface

g.text: cells refined or coarsened, nodes stay
Structured rectangular mesh, fixed all run
Every ASPECT step, with FastScape sub-steps
Unstructured triangular mesh, fixed, padded and perturbed
Every N DES steps or every t years
Δx / Δt, node displacement since the last coupling
Padded mesh; each side open, fixed or wall
